audit_items.proof_trace: Vesting terms (schedule parameters: vestingStartTime, vestingDurationSeconds, vestingCliffDurationSeconds, etc.) are never stored as mutable contract state — they are passed as signed calldata at claim time and locked into individual deployed vesting contracts. No function exists to modify an investor's already-deployed vesting schedule, and no pre-claim vesting-term slot in s_investorPositions can be altered post-withdrawal. The only post-withdrawal vesting-related update, syncLegionAddresses() (L682), changes infrastructure addresses (vestingFactory, vestingController) but not the actual vesting schedule parameters.
